xcalc 1.1.3 - X scientific calculator (Xaw)

Source: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/app/xcalc-1.1.3.tar.xz
Tarball: references/_tarballs/xcalc-1.1.3.tar.xz (once fetched)
Layout: app (flat - .c/.h at root of the extracted tree).
Copied into third-party/xcalc/: whole upstream tree, unmodified.

License: MIT/X11 (see COPYING).

Build: wired via demos/xcalc/CMakeLists.txt, which compiles xcalc.c,
actions.c, math.c and links emx11 + Xaw + Xmu + Xpm + Xt.

app-defaults: the Xaw layout depends heavily on app-defaults/XCalc.
The session harness stages that file into MEMFS at
/usr/lib/X11/app-defaults/XCalc via a preRun hook, which is where
libXt's default XFILESEARCHPATHDEFAULT pattern resolves it.

Upgrade procedure: bump the version in scripts/fetch-third-party.sh,
drop a fresh tarball into references/_tarballs/ (or let curl fetch),
and re-run the script.
